title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American run that will bring her back to headline stages across the United States and Canada in spring 2027.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American run that will bring her back to headline stages across the United States and Canada in spring 2027. The announcement follows a year in which she rebuilt her live schedule after cancelling every upcoming performance in 2025.

Young stepped away after collapsing during her set at All Things Go in New York in September 2025. Three days later, she told fans she was cancelling "everything for the foreseeable future" and needed time away. The decision wiped out a sold-out UK tour and a planned North American run that had been due to follow her album *I'm Only F**king Myself*.

Her return has happened in stages rather than through one immediate comeback tour. "Messy" won Best Pop Solo Performance at the Grammys in February, where she also performed the song. She then resumed headline shows in the UK and returned to festival bills through the year. By September, she was back at All Things Go, a year after the New York performance that preceded her break.

New music arrived alongside that return. "From Down Here," released in May, was the first new song after *I'm Only F**king Myself* and was created with James Blake. Young has said the idea arrived the day after the Grammys, sending her into the studio while the surprise of the win was still fresh. The song is less interested in extending the chaos of the previous album than in sitting with what remains after it.

Everything Begins opens in Nashville on April 6 and closes in Los Angeles on May 4. The announcement describes the U.S. shows as some of the largest headline rooms Young has booked there. Presales begin October 7, followed by the general sale on October 9 at 10 a.m. local time.

The tour name comes from Young's "Everything Ends" tattoo. When she cancelled her 2025 schedule, she asked fans to give her "a second chance" after she had taken time to work on herself. Everything Begins is the first North American tour announcement she has made since that message.
